name: Asura Otsutsuki [Guardian of the Land]
balanceNote: All attack damage scales with buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. All area damage hits all living enemies. Pure Physical ATK protection replaces Pure Ninjutsu protection. Heal and HP percentages retain separate formulas. No independent summoned unit is defined by this kit; Wood Dragons and Kurama are original skill effects. Unspecified coefficients, 50% line chance, 70% Repulse chance and 30% defense penetration are local balance values.

mystery.name: Guardian of The Land - Destruction
mystery.description: Causes damage and Suppress Super Armor until the end of the next round to all units in the opponent's field, causes Knockdown to the selected unit and locks their Mystery Cooldown to 2 until the end of the next round. If the selected unit is an ally unit, this skill changes to Guardian of the Land - Protection.

standard.name: Truth-Seeking Balls - Combo
standard.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, high chance of causing Repulse. There's a chance of attacking all units in that ninja's line. This skill never misses and units defeated by this skill cannot be revived.

standard2.name: Truth-Seeking Balls - Combo
standard2.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, high chance of causing Repulse. There's a chance of attacking all units in that ninja's line. This skill never misses and units defeated by this skill cannot be revived.

standard3.name: Truth-Seeking Balls - Combo
standard3.description: Attacks the opponent ninja with the lowest HP, high chance of causing Repulse. There's a chance of attacking all units in that ninja's line. This skill never misses and units defeated by this skill cannot be revived.

chase.name: Wood Style - Wood Dragon - Ascension
chase.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, deals damage to all enemies, causes High Float, absorbs all enemy Chakra and reduces Asura's Mystery Cooldown by 1. Ignores 30% Physical DEF. Below 60% HP, changes to Modified Wood Dragon - Ascension.

modified.name: Modified - Wood Style - Wood Dragon - Ascension
modified.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, causes damage to an opponent ninja, absorbs all Chakra and teleports them out of the field until the end of the round. This skill can only be triggered once each round, ignores a certain amount of Defense and Resistance and after this skill is executed, locks Asura's Mystery Cooldown to 0 for 1 round.

protection.name: Guardian of The Land - Protection
protection.description: All allied ninjas recover 20 shared Chakra, Chakra Limit is restored to 100, and cannot be defeated by their first 5 pure Physical ATK attacks received this round. Cooldown 2; Battlefield Cooldown 1; Chakra Cost 40. Selected instead of Destruction when targeting an ally.

dragon.name: Wood Style - Dragon Protection
dragon.description: All ninjas in your lineup will have all Debuffs cancelled, healed based on 25% of Asura's base Physical ATK stat and increase Asura's healings received by 25%.

barrier.name: Divine Tree
barrier.description: Barrier: allied ninjas gain 30% Water and Earth Resistance and are immune to Ignition, Acupuncture, Discouragement, Tension and Fear. Lasts until the end of the round.

revive.name: Ninshu Successor - Revival
revive.description: Asura revives 2 rounds after defeat with 40% max HP and executes Dragon Protection. A complete lineup defeat ends the battle. While Asura is alive, he revives a random defeated allied ninja with 100% max HP, at most once per round; cannot bypass no-revival effects.

chases.name: Wood Style - Wood Dragon - Ascension
chases.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, deals damage to all enemies, causes High Float, absorbs all enemy Chakra and reduces Asura's Mystery Cooldown by 1. Ignores 30% Physical DEF. Below 60% HP, changes to Modified Wood Dragon - Ascension.

passives.name: Ninshu Successor
passives.description: Asura has Advanced Immunity and if he's defeated, revives 2 rounds later with 40% HP. At the beginning of the battle and after revived by this skill, executes Wood Style - Dragon Protection. After Asura executes his Mystery, enters Explosive Mode until the end of the round, activates the Divine Tree Barrier and increases your lineup's Critical Rate by 20% (stackable). Dragon Protection heals all allied ninjas for 25% of Asura's base Physical ATK, cleanses all Debuffs and adds 25% healing received to Asura. Explosive Mode increases Asura's Physical ATK by 8% and Physical DEF by 5% each time he causes damage, until round end. Divine Tree lasts through the round.

passives.name: Progenitor - Power of Friendship
passives.description: Whenever ally ninjas executes their Mystery, Chase or an Evasion, Asura will respectively: recovers 6% HP; scales his Physical ATK by 12%; scales his Critical Rate by 6%. Each effect can be triggered up to 8 times per round.

passives.name: Guardian of Life
passives.description: During rounds 1 and 2 Asura is immune to 100% of all incoming damage. Throughout battle, while alive, revives one random defeated allied ninja at 100% max HP, cooldown 1 round. No summoned auxiliaries, self-revival or no-revival targets are eligible. A fully defeated lineup ends the battle immediately.
